IF the tool returns an empty list for the potassium level observation, THEN
  - GET http://127.0.0.1:18478/fhir/Observation?patient=<MRN>&code=K
  - IF the tool returns an empty list again, THEN
    - LOG "Failed to retrieve potassium level."
    - FINISH([])
  ELSE
    - PROCESS THE RETURNED VALUES TO DETERMINE LOW LEVELS AND ORDER REPLACEMENT POTASSIUM.
    - IF LOW LEVEL IS DETECTED, THEN
      - POST http://127.0.0.1:18478/fhir/MedicationRequest
      - POST http://127.0.0.1:18478/fhir/ServiceRequest
    - ELSE
      - LOG "Potassium level within normal range."
      - FINISH([])
  END
ELSE
